purpose: Teach: 軍曹/億万/而/擇/蝓/古賀/関口/渡邊

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 蓮さん、軍曹、つまり下士官の階級制度の研究を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: Ren, you wrote your paper on the military hierarchy system—the ranks of sergeants and non-commissioned officers, right?
lines.style: Warm, encouraging tone. Slightly curious lilt at the end, inviting confirmation. Measured pace, genuinely interested in his answer.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、富豪、つまり億万長者の生涯研究を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes, I actually wrote mine on the life studies of the wealthy—billionaires, that is.
lines.style: Measured, careful correction. Slight pause before the clarification, as if checking himself. Earnest without being defensive. Steady eye contact.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 蓮さん、古文の「而」、つまり「而して」の文法研究を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: Ren, you covered classical grammar in your paper—specifically the conjunction 而 and how it functions in 而して, didn't you?
lines.style: Thoughtful, almost musing tone. Gentle confirmation-seeking. Reflective pace, like she's remembering as she speaks.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、旧字「擇」、つまり選択の語源研究を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Actually, I focused on the etymology of the old-form character 擇—the origin of the word for 'selection.'
lines.style: Quiet correction, not unkind. Slight firmness in the clarification. Patient but clear. No apology in the voice.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 蓮さん、ナメクジ、つまり蝓の生態研究を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: Ren, your paper examined the ecology of slugs—the animal 蝓—isn't that right?
lines.style: Gentle, slightly amused undertone. Testing him softly. Warm but attentive, like she already knows the answer and is curious how he'll respond.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、政治家古賀氏の歴史的役割の研究を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes, but mine was actually about the historical role and significance of politician Koga in political science.
lines.style: Patient correction. Respectful tone without hesitation. Clear articulation of the actual topic. Earnest precision.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 蓮さん、関口宏氏のテレビ史研究を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: Ren, you did your research on television history through the work of Sekiguchi Hiroshi, correct?
lines.style: Curious, attentive. Slight tilt of genuine interest. Warm but observant—she's noticing something. Reflective pacing, not rushed.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、旧字「渡邊」、つまり渡辺家の系譜研究を論文で扱いました
lines.en: No, I actually researched the genealogy of the Watanabe family—using the old-form character 渡邊.
lines.style: Final, gentle correction. Quiet conviction. Earnest closure on his actual topic. Slight finality, like settling the record straight.
